card.name: Son Cubano
card.tagline: Foundational Cuban son, ancestor of salsa.
card.profile: Son cubano is a genre of music and dance originating in the highlands of eastern Cuba (Oriente - Sierra Maestra, Guantanamo, Baracoa, Santiago) in the late 19th century, a syncretic blend of Spanish (vocal style, guitar/tres, lyrical structure) and African Bantu (percussion, call-and-response) elements. Precursors include changui, nengon and kiriba. The classic 1920s Havana sextet standardized the format: tres, guitar, bongo, claves, maracas and double bass, later adding a trumpet (septeto). Danced by a couple, contratiempo (English Wikipedia; MasterClass).
card.insight: Son is widely called 'the father of salsa'; by the 1960s in New York it fused with other Latin styles to become salsa, and within Cuba it evolved into songo and timba (English Wikipedia).
